bull_bear.body:
- One of the global leaders in loyalty and engagement management with end-to-end SaaS suite (per Zinnov Report)
- Diversified enterprise customer base across verticals; 19 Global Fortune 500 companies as customers
- Global footprint - over 410 brands across 47 countries, 16 offices
- AI/ML-powered platform with competitive implementation speed as a differentiator
- Scalable cloud infrastructure hosting over 1.82 billion consumers as of Sept 30, 2025
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Customer concentration — Top five and top 10 customers contributed a significant portion of revenue (top 5/10 ~38.60% and above)
- Enterprise Customer dependence — ~97-98% of revenue from Enterprise Customers; loss of key accounts would materially impact revenue
- Business-model change in campaign services — Shift from principal to agent (net) recognition from FY25 reduces reported revenue and complicates comparability
- Industry report reliance — Market positioning claims derived from a Zinnov Report exclusively commissioned and paid for by the Company
- Technology and competition risk — Rapidly evolving SaaS/AI loyalty market with hybrid horizontal/vertical competitors
- Global operations risk — Presence across 47 countries exposes the Company to multi-jurisdiction legal, regulatory and FX risk
bull_bear.title: Bear — key risks

business.body: Capillary is a software product company offering AI-based cloud-native SaaS loyalty and engagement products (Loyalty+, Engage+, Insights+, Rewards+ and a Customer Data Platform) primarily to Enterprise Customers globally. It supports over 410 brands across 47 countries, enabling end-to-end loyalty programs, unified consumer views and cross-channel engagement.
business.title: What they do

business.body:
- **Loyalty:** Loyalty+ (loyalty management platform)
- **Engagement:** Engage+ (connected engagement platform)
- **Analytics:** Insights+ (predictive analytics platform), Customer Data Platform (CDP)
- **Rewards:** Rewards+ (rewards management platform)

outlook.body: Capillary intends to invest in cloud infrastructure, research/design/development of its products and platform, and computer systems, alongside inorganic growth via unidentified acquisitions, to build a generative AI-enabled loyalty platform and expand its global enterprise footprint.

risks.note: Company operates in a hybrid work environment amid an evolving cybersecurity threat landscape. It holds ISO 27001:2022 and PCI DSS 4.0.1 certifications and completes annual SOC 2 Type 2 and SOC 1 Type 2 attestations, but is still working toward HITRUST certification, indicating this remains an active, unresolved risk area for a SaaS platform business handling customer and consumer data.

The Company's revenue and operations are heavily linked to foreign currencies through its numerous overseas step-down subsidiaries and export-oriented service delivery, with foreign exchange inflows substantially exceeding outflows disclosed for FY26, exposing it to currency translation and transaction risk.

The Risk Management Committee's framework explicitly identifies financial, operational, sectoral, sustainability (environmental, social and governance), information and cybersecurity risks as the principal categories facing the Company, without further company-specific elaboration provided in this section of the report.
